clientIdRange: 1..9007199254740991; canonical decimal strings in URLs; JSON safe integer numbers in body
actor: validated cookie/current user + locked SQL User/UserSession; never authority from payload
branchAuthority: IPermissionService.EvaluateBranchAsync(INCIDENT_CREATE, branchId), active branch and placement locks
roomValidation: exists, active, same branch, active consistent floor/area; supplied area must equal authoritative room parent
assetValidation: same branch, not RETIRED, locked current location validates placement; supplied room/area must equal current asset parents
references: active SEVERITY/PRIORITY reference groups when supplied
transaction: existing local SQL transaction encompasses incident/event/audit/number allocation; caller rollback on failure; no RoomBlock/RoomStatus writes

csrf.transport: existing auth/http createHttpClient; credentials include, no-store, redirect error; no retries

responses.400: ValidationProblemDetails for model binding/annotations; ProblemDetails detail for source/placement; CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED middleware code
responses.401: authentication/session invalid (with valid CSRF for unsafe request)
responses.403: restricted session, forged reporter or denied branch permission
responses.503: pre-transaction permission data unavailable; SQL availability is not integration-verified

responseStatus: OPEN preserved; historical SRS Pending Triage label is not a new persisted status
